observations: Photo 0 and Photo 1 show a large industrial machine with blue and beige panels, mounted on wheels.
The machine has a vertical column with a control panel at the top, featuring gauges, a digital display, and buttons.
Below the column is a black assembly with two cylindrical components, likely molds or pistons.
To the right is a separate beige cabinet with a control panel and a green tool box on top.
The machine is in a room with barred windows and a tiled floor.
The watermark 'MARTHA OKPALA' is visible on both photos.
No visible brand or model name is readable on the machine in either photo.
